pagination.$description: Pagination: the page sizes, where the page stands among them all, the first, previous, next and last steps and a button per page around the current one; compact when it does not fit.

button-size.$description: The size of its buttons: sm, md, lg.

step-variant.$description: The look of the first, previous, next and last steps.

page-variant.$description: The look of a page button and of a page size.

page-tone.$description: The tone of a page button and of a page size.

current-variant.$description: The look of the current page and of the page size in use.

current-tone.$description: The tone of the current page and of the page size in use.

step-overlap.$description: How far the two arrows of the first and last steps go over each other.

number-width.$description: The page number box of the compact look.

size-width.$description: The drop-down of the page sizes in the compact look.

info.$description: Where the page stands: "Page 3 of 12 (250 items)".
